expand.title: throw to / throw at / throw away

parts.text: Throw to，Throw at & Throw away Qui te adv.相当地 & Qui et adj.安静的 Cause n.原因 v. 引起 & Reason n.理由 v. 推论出 "Cause" 和 "reason" 都可以表示原因，但在使用上有一些区别。"Cause" 通常用作名词，表示某事物导致或引起另一事物的发生，而 "reason" 既可以作名词也可以作动词，表示理由或原因，也可以表示推理或劝导。注意，"reason" 作为原因时通常与 "why" 引导的从句连用。 Drop (突然)掉下 & Fall (自然)掉下 "Drop" 和 "fall" 都涉及物体向下移动的概念，但它们的用法和强调点略有不同。"Drop" 更侧重于物体因失去支持或不小心掉下来，而 "fall" 更强调物体自然或有意识地向下移动或落下。

headers: throw at 对准某一目标扔
rows: He threw the ball to me, and I caught it.
The boy threw a stone at the window and broke it.
Many people throw away cigarette ends carelessly.

headers: Quite adv. 表示程度或程度上的强调
Quiet adj. 描述缺乏噪音、平静或寂静的状态；也可用作名词
rows: She is quite talented.（她非常有才华。） The movie was quite interesting.（这部电影相当有趣。）
Please be quiet in the library.（请在图书馆保持安静。） The night was so quiet that you could hear a pin drop.（夜晚如此寂静，你甚至能听到掉针的声音。）

headers: Cause sb. to do sth. 导致某人做某事
rows: Do you know the cause of the war? What was the cause of the delay?
Give me your reasons for going there. What was the reason for the delay?
How can you reason with him when he is so worried?
His behavior caused her to become upset.
That was the reason why the meeting was put off.

headers: Drop v.（使）掉下，（使）落下，放下（强调的是不小心掉下来）
Fall v.落下，（雨、雪）下，降，跌倒，摔倒（强调的是掉下来的概念，动作）
rows: As he walked past the tree, an apple dropped from it. The waiter dropped a fork.
I fell and hurt myself. When leaves fall in autumn, I'll come back.
